Subject: e-legal workflow sourcing: procurement checklist & next steps

Team / vendors —

Thanks for the materials so far. We're consolidating our CLM + e-sign workflow tools and want to run a short, focused procurement exercise over the next two weeks. Attached is a working procurement checklist (procurement-checklist.xlsx) — please review and confirm which items you can answer/confirm in writing and which will require a short follow-up call. High-level asks: 

- Migration approach & estimated downtime/impact for customers during cutover
- Pricing model for committed vs on-demand tiers (volume bands + seats)
- Security/compliance: SOC2 report, KMS integrations, key rotation cadence
- SSO & SCIM provisioning details (IdP compatibility)
- Data residency options and export formats for contract archives

If possible, please send a short (1–2 page) summary and any pricing worksheets by end-of-day Wednesday (2026-12-01). We'll run a vendor comparison and pick two vendors for final demo + negotiation.

Proposed times for a 30m clarifying call next week (PST): Mon 12/06 10:00 or Tue 12/07 14:00. Please indicate availability.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Head of Sales, Contracts & GTM
Redwood Inference

Diego —

Appreciate the checklist. Attached is a short proposal and a one-page migration outline (ironclad-proposal.pdf). Quick answers to your bullets: 

- Migration: we support staged migration with prefix-based routing; typical customer migration for ~500 active contracts takes 2–3 business days with no customer-facing downtime.
- Pricing: we offer committed enterprise bands (annual commit) and on-demand usage. I'll include a sample pricing sheet in the follow-up CSV.
- Security: SOC2 Type II available; we support KMS via AWS KMS and bring-your-own-key in dedicated plans; key rotation is configurable and auditable.
- SSO/SCIM: Okta, Azure AD supported; SCIM connector for user provisioning.
- Data residency: export via S3-compatible archive (JSON + PDF); we can retain archives in EU/US regions on request.

We can do Tue 12/07 14:00 PST for a 30m sync. I'll bring our solutions engineer to cover migration details.

Best,
Asha Patel
Senior Solutions Architect, Ironclad

A few legal points to flag before we go deeper: 

- Contract term standardization: we prefer evergreen + 60-day termination with data export guarantee. If a vendor requires multi-year lock-in with heavy exit fees, escalate.
- Data processing addendum: must include subprocessor list and 30-day notification for changes.
- Audit rights: need quarterly audit evidence or attestation for SOC2 controls relevant to contract signing workflows.

I'll prepare a short redline template to attach to the final RFx; Markus, can you confirm procurement budget window so we can set negotiation targets?
